newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar gains after recent fall on thin supply.
newsitem.headline: India sugar gains after recent fall on thin supply.

text.p: Indian sugar prices regained on Tuesday after recent losses, as thin supplies kept the market firm, dealers said.
They said there was increased buying by neighbouring states from local millers, which in turn curtailed arrivals of sugar.
In ready delivery sugar S/30 rose by 2/4 rupees to 1,245/1,290 while sugar M/30 rose by 3/5 rupees to 1,270/1,325.
Sugar mill delivery also gained by five to 1,185/1,205.
